cards.front: Name the layers of Earth from the outside to the centre.
cards.back: Crust, mantle, outer core, inner core.
cards.say: Name the layers of Earth from the outside to the centre. Crust, mantle, outer core, inner core.

cards.back: The thin, rocky outer layer of Earth. We live on it.
cards.say: crust. The thin, rocky outer layer of Earth. We live on it.

cards.back: The thick layer of hot rock under the crust. It flows very slowly.
cards.say: mantle. The thick layer of hot rock under the crust. It flows very slowly.

cards.back: A layer of very hot liquid metal, mostly iron and nickel.
cards.say: outer core. A layer of very hot liquid metal, mostly iron and nickel.

cards.back: The solid metal centre of Earth. It is extremely hot.
cards.say: inner core. The solid metal centre of Earth. It is extremely hot.

cards.back: Huge pieces of crust and upper mantle that fit together like a jigsaw.
cards.say: tectonic plates. Huge pieces of crust and upper mantle that fit together like a jigsaw.

cards.front: How fast do tectonic plates move?
cards.back: Very slowly, a few centimetres each year.
cards.say: How fast do tectonic plates move? Very slowly, a few centimetres each year.

cards.back: A place where two tectonic plates meet.
cards.say: plate boundary. A place where two tectonic plates meet.

cards.back: A shaking of the ground when plates suddenly move or slip.
cards.say: earthquake. A shaking of the ground when plates suddenly move or slip.

cards.back: The place under the ground where an earthquake starts.
cards.say: focus. The place under the ground where an earthquake starts.

cards.back: The point on the surface directly above the focus of an earthquake.
cards.say: epicentre. The point on the surface directly above the focus of an earthquake.

cards.back: An instrument that detects and records the shaking of an earthquake.
cards.say: seismometer. An instrument that detects and records the shaking of an earthquake.

cards.front: What is the Ring of Fire?
cards.back: A ring of volcanoes and earthquake zones around the Pacific Ocean. Indonesia is part of it.
cards.say: What is the Ring of Fire? A ring of volcanoes and earthquake zones around the Pacific Ocean. Indonesia is part of it.

cards.back: An opening in the crust where magma, ash and gas escape.
cards.say: volcano. An opening in the crust where magma, ash and gas escape.

cards.back: Hot melted rock underground.
cards.say: magma. Hot melted rock underground.

cards.back: Magma that has reached the surface.
cards.say: lava. Magma that has reached the surface.

cards.back: The opening at the top of a volcano where material comes out.
cards.say: vent. The opening at the top of a volcano where material comes out.

cards.front: How is a mountain range formed?
cards.back: Two plates push against each other and the crust is crumpled and pushed upwards.
cards.say: How is a mountain range formed? Two plates push against each other and the crust is crumpled and pushed upwards.

cards.back: A volcano that has erupted recently or may erupt soon.
cards.say: active volcano. A volcano that has erupted recently or may erupt soon.

cards.back: A sleeping volcano that has not erupted for a long time but may erupt again.
cards.say: dormant volcano. A sleeping volcano that has not erupted for a long time but may erupt again.

cards.back: A volcano that will not erupt again.
cards.say: extinct volcano. A volcano that will not erupt again.

cards.back: A giant sea wave, usually caused by an undersea earthquake or eruption.
cards.say: tsunami. A giant sea wave, usually caused by an undersea earthquake or eruption.

cards.front: What should you do in an earthquake?
cards.back: Drop to the ground, take cover under a strong table and hold on until the shaking stops.
cards.say: What should you do in an earthquake? Drop to the ground, take cover under a strong table and hold on until the shaking stops.

cards.front: Why do many people live near volcanoes?
cards.back: Volcanic soil is very fertile, so crops grow well.
cards.say: Why do many people live near volcanoes? Volcanic soil is very fertile, so crops grow well.
